name: Sawaki Yuki
source:
Daughter of Yumi Sawaki and Akagawa Yuuki from Milkyway 2.

Grand-daughter of Sawaki Yuriko from Alive.

Great-grand-daughter of Sawaki Marie from Alive.

Her alias "Sakagami Yuzuka" shares the family name of Sakagami Yuzuki, a character in Alive.
